name: Prediction block renders cleanly at 360px viewport
description: A match detail page loads and the prediction block contains all required elements: a winner label, a scoreline, and probability information.

planSteps.description: Resize the viewport to a 360px-wide mobile size
Click any match link to open a match detail page

Verify that at the 360px mobile width the prediction block lays out its winner, scoreline, and outcome probabilities readably without overflow, clipping, or horizontal overlap, and all three are legible
